subject: Customer request: KEK wrapping + supply-chain attestation for SOC2
messages:
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@clearwave.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearwave.com
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Encryption design details & KEK wrapping for SOC2 audit

Hi Jonas,

We're prepping for our SOC2 in Q4 and our audit team has a few focused asks around tenant key ownership and key-wrapping across the supply chain. Could you confirm the following and provide artifacts by EOD next Tuesday (2028-09-26) if possible?

1) Do you support customer- or tenant-specific KEKs (wrapped by a hardware-protected KEK) versus a platform-managed KEK? If you support tenant KEKs, we need a short description of the provisioning flow and any operator access controls.

2) HSM attestation: we need the current attestation cert for the HSM module(s) used to protect the KEK (vendor, model, firmware, signed cert).

3) Rotation evidence: a sample of rotation logs (last 90 days), showing key versioning, rotate timestamps, and the identity that performed the rotation. Redacted identities are OK but need consistent identifiers.

4) Key wrapping proof: a small sample showing the wrapped KEK blob and the algorithm/parameters used (no plaintext key material).

5) Network transport & TLS: confirmation that wrapping/unwrapping happens inside the HSM or over mTLS channels and any cert references.

Attachments: CW_Security_Questionnaire_v2.pdf (attached) — we've flagged the KEK/Wrapping questions under section 4.

Thanks — Alice
Security Assurance | ClearWave
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@clearwave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption design details & KEK wrapping for SOC2 audit

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you requested. Quick summary and a couple of clarifying questions so we deliver exactly what you need: 

- Tenant KEKs: Redwood supports both platform-managed KEKs and customer-managed envelope keys (BYOK) depending on plan. For ClearWave's Dedicated deployment we recommend tenant-bound KEKs that are wrapped by an HSM-protected platform KEK (envelope encryption).

- HSM attestation: we can provide the vendor-signed attestation cert for the HSM cluster protecting the platform KEK.

- Rotation logs: we'll export a redacted CSV with the last 90 days (rotate events, version ids, actor id) — no secret values.

- Sample wrapped KEK: we will include a binary blob plus a short explanation of algorithm and parameters (RSA-OAEP / AES-KW or AES-GCM wrap depending on profile).

Questions: 
1) For the wrapped KEK sample, do you need a specific key-wrap algorithm called out (e.g., AES-KWP vs RSA-OAEP), or is a generic explanation + parameters sufficient?
2) Does ClearWave require a customer-side HSM attestation (i.e., you manage the KEK in your HSM) or will a Redwood-signed attestation plus the vendor certificate meet the audit requirement?

I'll coordinate on timeline with the crypto ops team. Marcus — can you pull the attestation cert and a 90-day rotation export? Laura — pinging you for a quick approval on the redaction policy we should use for actor identities.

Best,
Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@clearwave.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption design details & KEK wrapping for SOC2 audit

Jonas — thanks. For ClearWave's auditor we'd prefer: 
- Tenant-specific KEK ownership is ideal (we're OK with Redwood providing a wrapped KEK but we prefer the KEK root to be customer-controlled in a customer-managed HSM). If that is not possible, a vendor-signed attestation of the HSM plus a contractual clause limiting Redwood operator access will be required.
- For the sample wrapped KEK, please include the exact algorithm/cipher suite you used.

Procurement note: if Redwood supports customer-managed HSMs we will need a short statement of the integration steps and any dependencies. Our procurement contact is security@clearwave.com.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alice
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Encryption design details & KEK wrapping for SOC2 audit

Team — tagging for action. Marcus, please prepare the following artifacts for ClearWave:

1) hsm_attestation_thales_luna_v4.pem (vendor-signed attestation cert + metadata file with serial/firmware)
2) redwood_kek_rotation_log_90d.csv (redacted actor ids; keep consistent pseudonyms)
3) envelope_encryption_flow.drawio (diagram that shows KEK wrapping, where unwrapping occurs, and network boundaries)
4) sample_wrapped_kek.bin (sample wrapped blob; ensure no plaintext, include accompanying parameters.txt describing algorithm/IV/tag)
5) short note on operator access controls & separation of duties (one-page)

Redaction policy: replace full user principals with stable t-IDs (e.g., t-ops-34) and include a mapping for auditors only under NDA (we will not send the mapping until requested).

Jonas — please confirm whether we should provide a signed attestation from the HSM vendor or a Redwood-signed statement in addition to the vendor cert. Marcus — estimate for delivery?

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@clearwave.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Encryption design details & KEK wrapping for SOC2 audit

Hi Alice / team — quick update and list of deliverables we'll upload to the drive link below by EOD tomorrow (2028-09-21):

Deliverables (attached/uploaded):
- hsm_attestation_thales_luna_v4.pem — vendor-signed attestation (Thales Luna v4), includes firmware serial and signing chain
- redwood_kek_rotation_log_90d.csv — rotate_time, key_id, new_version, previous_version, actor_tid (redacted), rotate_reason
- sample_wrapped_kek.bin — encrypted blob produced with AES-KWP (RFC 5649) wrapping a 256-bit DEK; accompanying parameters.txt enumerates algorithm, wrapping_key_id, wrapping_iv, tag (where applicable)
- envelope_encryption_flow.drawio — end-to-end diagram (where KEK lives, wrap/unwrapping boundaries, network controls)
- operator_access_controls.pdf — short separation-of-duties and emergency-unwrap process (who can request, who approves)

Notes / clarifications:
- We perform wrapping/unwrapping inside an HSM boundary for platform KEKs. For customer-managed HSM (BYOK) integrations we provide a handshake + wrap exchange where the customer-provided key is wrapped by our platform KEK only at provisioning time; unwrapping remains under customer control if they host the KEK in their HSM.
- Rotation cadence: default is 90-day rekey for KEK metadata; DEKs rotate per-tenant on demand or per policy. The rotation_log shows timestamps and pseudonymized actor IDs.
- Attestation: we'll provide both the vendor attestation cert and a Redwood-signed attestation letter that summarizes control points (no private key material included).

Upload link (private): https://drive.redwood.internal/shared/CW-KMS-Evidence-2028
HubSpot: HS-REC-99823 (linked record)

If you need a live walkthrough of the artifacts before the auditor review, I can hop on a 30-min call Thursday.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Crypto Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
